identity.productId: retailer advertiser MID + product link ID
identity.variantId: SKU when the response includes a non-empty sku
identity.advertiserFilter: The caller may supply an advertiser MID after confirming it is a relevant publisher partner. No advertiser MID is hardcoded.

request.tokenInput: Caller supplies the publisher token to the client in process memory. This module does not create an application, acquire a token, persist credentials, send cookies or generate tracking links.
request.tokenLifecycle: The Developer Portal guide says a publisher application is created before generating an API access token; generated tokens remain valid for 60 minutes. No app or token was created in this task.

documentedQueryFields.one: Search for at least one term
documentedQueryFields.language: Language filter; currently documented values include en_US, fr_FR, de_DE and pt_BR

request.queryTermRule: At most one of keyword, exact, one or none per request. Product Search supports category, language, page size, page, advertiser MID and one sort field.

itemFields.price[@currency]: Reported retail price and its currency
itemFields.saleprice[@currency]: Reported sale price and its currency, returned separately
itemFields.linkurl: Publisher product/tracking URL; kept distinct from canonical merchant URL

response.priceSemantics: The client preserves price and saleprice as separate reported values. It does not infer whether a sale is currently active or calculate a landed price.
response.inventorySemantics: Availability is unknown; Product Search does not document an on-hand stock field.

officialMaximumConflict.handling: The client conservatively caps full collection at 1000 results and marks any larger TotalMatches as potentially truncated. It does not claim the result set is exhausted.

sephora.programEvidence: Sephora's US affiliate page directs publishers to Rakuten Advertising.
sephora.separateCreatorProgram: My Sephora Storefront is also listed on the same page as a separate creator storefront program.
sephora.midPolicy: No MID is guessed or embedded. The caller must supply the MID associated with their applicable, approved advertiser partnership.
sephora.commissionRatePolicy: No public percentage is inferred. Product Search does not return commission rates.

entitlement.note: The official API searches partner-advertiser product data. The supplied MID filter narrows a catalog query; it is not an advertiser application.

limits: A local contract test is not an authenticated catalog replay.
A successful publisher token alone would not establish the current publisher's Sephora partnership or advertiser MID.
No account signup, app creation, advertiser application or link-generation write is implemented here.
